result.title: Proposal 2
result.description: Proposed Mapping revision architecture integrated into the existing PersistentLayer and Canvas domain model canvases. Six targeted existing-diagram updates plus four connected detail diagrams: durable revision records, publish-time merge, shared diagram editing/resolution, and ChangeSession/alternative contexts. Original canvases remain unchanged.

changes.title: Replace embedded diagram ownership with editing contexts and resolver access
[A] Resolve diagram identity into layout content
[B] Separate resolved diagram state from immutable revision identity
[C] Reanchor overview connection; FloatingBox content and placement unchanged
[D] Locate DiagramEditService, its callers, resolver and fork/publication operations
Add DiagramEditService editing, durable checkpoints and resolution
Add forked ChangeSession review and independent alternative-canvas flows
Separate immutable diagram/canvas history, context storage and automatic publication
Add RevisionStore records, immutable histories and context relationships
Add publication lifecycle and black-box merge interface
